comment: Text-only QAT-mobile ONNX evaluation, not shipping. Apache License 2.0 verified at https://ai.google.dev/gemma/docs/gemma_4_license (export has no LICENSE file). onnx-community export of google/gemma-4-E2B-it-qat-mobile-transformers; exporter/base SHA not documented, artifact revision and HF LFS SHA256s pinned instead. Mixed QAT precision, q2f16 is the artifact suffix, not uniformly 2-bit weights. Transformers.js 4.3.2 Gemma4ForCausalLM selects embeddings and decoder only. Native Gemma tools; template supports tools and enable_thinking=false. Vendor recommends T=1/top_p=.95/top_k=64; controlled comparison uses Pouch T=.3/top_p=.95 and greedy, no thinking. Text assets 2,324,194,060 bytes; shader-f16 required. Actual RSS measured, no shipping memory acceptance implied.
